title: Pointwise composition law for structure-sheaf cohomology pullback
statement: For composable scheme morphisms f : X ⟶ Y and g : Y ⟶ Z, every n and every x : Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb Z) n, structureSheafCohomologyPullback (f ≫ g) n x = structureSheafCohomologyPullback f n (structureSheafCohomologyPullback g n x).

proof.text: Apply the proved library theorem CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.exactFunctorCompositionComparison to the natural isomorphism from the inverse-image functor of f composite g to the composite inverse-image functors. This identifies their Ext maps after pre- and postcomposition with the degree-zero comparison components.

Use uniqueness of left adjoints to compare the inverse-image functor of f composite g with the composite inverse-image functors. Applying the hom equivalences shows that the adjoint structure-sheaf morphisms compose across this comparison (adjoint_comp_mate). Applying the constant-sheaf adjunctions and their units likewise shows that the inverse constant-sheaf comparisons compose (adjoint_constant_comp). Both helpers are proved in the module.

Expand structureSheafCohomologyPullback as the Yoneda product of the constant-sheaf comparison, the exact-functor image of the class, and the adjoint structure-sheaf map. Substitute the preceding comparison equalities; use exactFunctorCompositionComparison and associativity of Yoneda products to identify it with the two successive pullbacks.

proof_origin.place: Section 01F7 equation-functorial; Ext and adjunction coherence made explicit in Lean
